== Images ==

Hello. Thanks for adding those images. We are always looking for good pictures of the characters and all things WoT-related. I think, though, that only the close-up of Verin should go on her page, just so that the page isn't too cluttered. The larger one can definitely stay on the Battle page. Also, if you could, please add the {{tl|Image}} tempalte to both of the images. If you have any questions, please let me know. Thanks again! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 12:28, August 22, 2012 (UTC)

Now that I look at it a bit more, both of the images are fine on Verin's page. :) ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 12:33, August 22, 2012 (UTC)
